translations.web: When the Pharisees saw it, they said to his disciples, “Why does your teacher eat with tax collectors and sinners?”
translations.bsb: When the Pharisees saw this, they asked His disciples, “Why does your Teacher eat with tax collectors and sinners?”
translations.kjv: And when the Pharisees saw it, they said unto his disciples, Why eateth your Master with publicans and sinners?
translations.asv: And when the Pharisees saw it, they said unto his disciples, Why eateth your Teacher with the publicans and sinners?
